name: Where should I invest my budget when remodeling a compact kitchen?

mainEntity.name: Where should I invest my budget when remodeling a compact kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: In a small kitchen, prioritize deep base drawers, tall vertical cabinetry, and durable, low-maintenance countertops. Deep drawers hold pots, pans, and dry goods much more efficiently than traditional lower cabinets with doors, which require reaching into dark corners. Investing in durable countertops like quartz offers stain resistance in high-use preparation spaces. You can balance your budget by choosing standard-dimension appliances and classic subway or ceramic tile backsplashes rather than costly specialty tiles, preserving your renovation dollars for functional storage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Invest in functional cabinetry, like deep base pull-out drawers, and durable countertops. Save money on simpler tile backsplashes and standard appliance sizes.
